detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Anonymous: visits, pages, sources, devices and countries. Sessions: each visit in a browser tab also gets a random session id (kept in that tab's session storage, never a cross-site id), its browser and system family and its city, for sessions, bounce, duration, journeys, live visitors, Web Vitals per page and 404 referrers. Sessions are still anonymous: no IP address, user agent or cookie is kept.

retentionMonths.title: Keep raw events (months)
retentionMonths.description: Raw events are removed by your database's expiry index after this many months (applies to events recorded from now on). Daily totals are kept forever.

requireConsent.title: Count only after analytics consent
requireConsent.description: Visits, events, searches and Web Vitals are recorded only once the visitor consents to analytics.

recordCountry.title: Record the visitor's country (and city)
recordCountry.description: From your host's country header (and its city header with Detail set to Sessions); no IP address is ever kept.
